response.justification: The candidate lacks the mandatory C++ experience on Windows systems and domain expertise in fixed income or capital markets. While they have extensive software development experience, their background is heavily focused on web, mobile, and embedded systems with languages like TypeScript, JavaScript, D, and Java. Their work in financial services (RIDE Capital, Dunnhumby) does not align with the required domain expertise in fixed income or capital markets.
strengths: Strong software development fundamentals and problem-solving skills
Experience with SQL and database management
Proven ability to learn and adapt to new technologies
concerns: No demonstrated C++ experience on Windows systems (5–10 years required)
Lacks domain expertise in fixed income, capital markets, or investment banking
Primary expertise in non-C++ languages (TypeScript, JavaScript, D, Java)
